title: Red boundaries
line: Five days, one clear boundary a day.
intro: Athena’s favourite line of the Orphic hymn calls Ares the ἕρκος Ὀλύμπου, the fence of Olympus: our centre is wisdom, but our edges must be red. Creation, the soul and awakening all need guarding, and the greater the treasure, the higher the walls. For five days, set one clear boundary a day.
does: Each day, set one clear boundary where you usually let things through.
trains: Guarding what is precious in you, with wisdom at the centre.
each: Today, set one clear boundary where you usually let something through: a no to a request that drains you, an hour when you stop answering messages, a conversation you step out of, a time kept for your practice. Keep it firmly and calmly, with wisdom at the centre: a wall around a treasure.
note: Which boundary did you set today, and what did it guard?
end: After five days: which treasure in you most needed its walls, and who are the people who help you guard it, your ἕρκος, your fence?
